fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description:
Detects the use of at/atd which are utilities that are used to schedule tasks.
They are often abused by adversaries to maintain persistence or to perform task scheduling for initial or recurring execution of malicious code
fields.name: Scheduled Task/Job At
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="linux" and (tgt.process.image.path contains "/at" or tgt.process.image.path contains "/atd"))
